title: Lyme Model v0.2 MVP Evaluation (Week 20)
methodology: Compare A) raw local model vs B) Lyme Model runtime on repo Q&A, patch planning, tiny fixes, bug localization.

A_raw_local_model.description: Direct Ollama prompting without context compilation or tool use

B_lyme_model_runtime.description: Lyme Model with context compiler, tool session, QA engine, benchmark harness
B_lyme_model_runtime.evidence_grounding: file citations, source excerpts, evidence chains
B_lyme_model_runtime.hardware_cost: low (static analysis, no GPU needed for basic Q&A)

what_worked: Context compilation with task-relevant file ranking (0.24 -> 0.71 keyword coverage)
Readonly tool safety (edit/run_test correctly blocked in readonly mode)
Evidence-grounded Q&A (file citations + source excerpts with latency tracking)
Context packet system for long-context simulation (task/subtask decomposition)
Audit trace integration (all context compilations, tool calls, QA answers traced)
what_failed: Risky file detection benchmark at 0% — keyword-only detection is insufficient; needs git change frequency + dependency depth analysis
Regression/bug localization at 33% — needs AST-aware search and import graph traversal
Improved compiler tokens +86% vs current — need compression for 3B model context windows
what_actually_improved_local_models: Task-relevant file ranking (keyword + import scoring) dramatically reduces hallucination by constraining model to relevant files
Readonly tool safety + evidence tracking enables trustworthy static analysis without GPU
Context packets with evidence chains enable longer reasoning chains within small context windows
Latency tracking + audit traces enable systematic benchmarking and iteration
what_should_be_cut: Context benchmark 'token reduction vs raw' metric (misleading — context is supposed to add information)
Manual framework detection without real import resolution (false positives for framework name in unrelated paths)
what_should_become_v1_focus: 1. AST-aware file ranking for bug localization (replace keyword scoring with symbol resolution)
2. Git-aware risk detection (change frequency + dependency depth instead of keyword)
3. Aggressive context compression for 3B models (truncate API surface, keep only ranked files)
4. Ollama integration for semantic answers (combine static analysis with model generation)
5. Interactive session mode (model requests tools, gets output, cites evidence in loop)

hardware_profile.runtime_without_gpu: Fully functional for static analysis Q&A, context compilation, tool use

files_added_during_implementation: src/lyme_model/context/improved.py (W2 improved context with file ranking)
